assumptions.statement: The migration to AWS requires establishing a VPN connection to the existing Carrenza system.
assumptions.quote: we need to use a VPN to talk to Carrenza

assumptions.statement: The previously assigned IP address ranges for Staging and Production conflict with the Carrenza network, preventing direct communication or causing routing issues.
The migration to AWS is being conducted gradually, implying that the old and new environments must coexist and communicate during the transition.
assumptions.quote: As part of the gradual migration of Staging and Production to AWS
